incident-bot: [ALERT] billing-telemetry: detected sustained sample-skew in usage-emitter (5m avg > 7% deviation). Some customers flagged for overages. Runbook: /runbooks/billing-sample-skew 
oncall-sre: acked, looking. tagging @billing-eng and @data-platform :eyes:
billing-eng: saw the alert. initial glance: emission sampler dropped ~1% of tokens for a subset of windows, plus late-window buffering. pushing logs now.
billing-eng: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T20:02:11Z emitter-window id=20260317-2000 sampled=99876 expected=100987 delta=-1111
2026-03-17T20:03:11Z emitter-window id=20260317-2001 sampled=99880 expected=100990 delta=-1110
```
data-platform: we see correlated Kafka consumer lag on partition 12 during 20:01-20:05 UTC. consumer group: usage-emit-consumers-3. likely replay/dup suppression upstream?
oncall-sre: any customer-visible deltas? @support-lead?
support-lead: support queue has 4 inbound tickets mentioning unexpected overage emails since 20:10 UTC. IDs: C-8132, C-8135, C-8140, C-8142. no refunds yet.
emma: triage question — are these false positives (shadow counts) or undercounts leading to later replays that spike charged tokens?
billing-eng: looks like undercount during windows then a compensating backfill later which triggers anomaly detection that marks overage. two customers hit threshold during the backfill window.
oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause anomaly-triggering pipeline (anomaly-detector) for 10m to avoid automated overage emails 2) enable manual hold on alerts for affected accounts 3) run targeted replay of missing windows into reconciliation queue.
raj: I can own the replay and reconciliation. starting a dry-run against staging shard for partition 12 now. ETA 12m.
billing-eng: creating temporary override to suppress automatic overage notifications for accounts [acct-993, acct-1002] while we reconcile. documenting in incident notes.
support-lead: letting CS know to hold on informing customers until we confirm corrected counts. flagged VIP accounts to PM.
oncall-sre: handing off pager to @raj (data-platform) for live replay and reconciliation. I'll remain on-call for orchestration. please post progress updates here. :thumbsup:
raj: started replay dry-run. preliminary results show corrected counts reconciling within acceptable delta (~0.2%). will escalate to prod replay after validation.
incident-bot: [NOTE] created incident ticket I-2026-03317-007. responders: oncall-sre, raj, billing-eng, support-lead.
billing-eng: after prod replay we should also adjust emitter sampling metric alerts and add consumer-lag guard to prevent auto-replay loops. filing follow-up task.
support-lead: preparing templated customer note in case we need to notify. will queue for review.
oncall-sre: update at +45m or earlier if blocking. handing off full operational responsibility to @raj at 20:28 UTC.
raj: prod replay started at 20:30 UTC. monitoring reconciliation dashboard. will post final reconciliation summary once complete.
billing-eng: confirmed suppressed overage emails. will lift suppression after final reconciliation and manual check.
support-lead: keeping CS on standby. no customer notifications yet.
raj: reconciliation complete at 20:56 UTC. affected accounts reconciled, overage flags cleared, and compensating tokens applied where needed. final diffs attached to ticket I-2026-03317-007.
oncall-sre: closing active pager. marking incident status: mitigated -> postmortem required. assigning to @billing-eng for root cause and to @data-platform for consumer-lag instrumentation.
incident-bot: [CLOSE] incident I-2026-03317-007 moved to "mitigated". Postmortem required within 3 business days.
